test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All oranges are apples.

All apples are grapes.

Conclusions:

(I) Some apples are oranges.

(II) All grapes are oranges.
solution:

Conclusions:

(I) Some apples are oranges. - True ( All oranges are Apple means some orange is apple and some apple is orange.Hence, it is true.

(II) All grapes are oranges. - False ( All oranges is Apple and All apple is Grapes.All Grapes are oranges is possible but not definte. Hence, it is false.)

Only conclusion (I) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
